validity_findings.finding: Conditional PMI at K=3 = 0.0 bits on all 5 variants is mathematically forced by deterministic TodoMVC FSM structure, not a pipeline artifact. With 3-4 hash states and deterministic (url_before, action) -> url_after, conditioning on H_K=3 (url_before, last 3 actions) uniquely identifies current FSM state, making url_after constant within each (url_before, H_3) stratum. Independent recomputation confirms n_strata_used 10/10/7/10/10 with zero variance strata 10/10/6/10/10 and nonzero strata =0 for all variants. Contributing transitions 60/93 (vanillajs/react/angular/svelte) and 43/85 (vue) - remaining 33/42 transitions in 13/17 small strata (n<5) excluded per prereg MIN_STRATUM_SIZE=5. Weighted PMI sum exactly 0.0. This validates producer validity_notes[0] and report.md 'Markov Ceiling' interpretation.

validity_findings.finding: Action-history prediction accuracy at K=3 = 1.0 on 4/5 variants and 0.9535 on vue (41/43 correct). At K=0 accuracy 0.9247 and K=1 accuracy 0.951-0.978, monotonic increase to ceiling confirms (url_before, H_K=3) fully determines url_after. Therefore I(url_after; action | url_before, H_3)=0 is identity (Y constant given X => MI=0), not estimator underpower. Producer correctly identifies as Markov ceiling in validity_notes[0][1].

Positive control synthetic deterministic SPA (8 states, 3 actions form_submit/button_click/js_navigate, deterministic mapping per SYNTHETIC_TRANSITIONS, 100 sessions x50 steps N=5000) achieves PMI at K=3 =1.495804 bits, permutation p=0.000999, effect_d=182.57, n_strata 244, n_used 186. Threshold >=1.0 bits and p<0.001 both passed. Independent recomputation matches 1.495804... exactly. Critically, control uses same history-conditioned pipeline (K=3) unlike parent's unconditional control, validating that pipeline CAN detect structure when history does NOT fully determine next state (8 states >3-action alphabet, K=3 insufficient to disambiguate). No misspecification.

Null controls both pass: (1) Normalized URL PMI (fragment-stripped, alpha=0) =0.0 bits exactly on all variants (unique normalized states=1, entropy 0.0, correct nosmooth handling fixing parent V1 Laplace artifact). (2) Shuffled-action permutation null means at K=3: -0.0124/-0.0124/-0.0117/-0.0122/-0.0124 bits, close to expected 0.0 and well below observed 0.0 (effect_d negative -0.13 to -0.18, p=1.0). Demonstrates estimator unbiased under null and not inflating PMI.

validity_findings.finding: Permutation test shuffles action labels within each trajectory (preserves action distribution, destroys action->url_after association), 1000 perms seed=42, cross-trajectory per prereg. Counts >= observed with +1 smoothing gives minimum p=0.000999. At K=3 p=1.0 (1000/1000 >=0.0) correctly reflects null distribution centered near 0.0 with small variance (null_std 0.004-0.007). Bonferroni correction 5 comparisons alpha=0.01 applied correctly (prereg: p_bonf = min(p*5,1.0) implicit via threshold comparison). Method is appropriate for I(url_after; action | url_before, H_K) conditional null.

validity_findings.finding: C-WEB-DYNAMICS requires 'predictive dynamical structure beyond memory and ordinary similarity.' This experiment directly operationalizes beyond-memory test as I(url_after; action | url_before, H_K=3) with falsifier 0.05 bits on >=3/5 variants and Bonferroni p<0.01, plus history-length baselines K=0/1 and accuracy tracking. Unlike parent EXP-PHYSICS-35262258744 (audit V7: identifiability not demonstrated due to missing history baseline), this experiment provides the missing identifiability test. Operational mathematical object (conditional PMI), observable (bits), falsifier (>0.05 on >=3/5), strong nulls (shuffled), and threshold are fully specified per AGENTS.md Physics discipline. Result FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING is valid identifiability conclusion, not graph reuse.

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING: On TodoMVC hash-SPA testbeds (vanillajs, react, vue, angular, svelte) with 3-4 hash states, deterministic (url_before, action) -> url_after, action_primitive {form_submit, button_click, js_navigate}, fragment-preserving URL representation, non-leakage filter action_primitive!='link_click', 85-93 NL transitions per variant, I(url_after; action | url_before, H_K=3)=0.0 bits on 0/5 variants (threshold >0.05, Bonferroni p<0.01 both fail; p=1.0, accuracy 1.0/0.953 at K=3). The parent 0.188-0.209 bit unconditional PMI is entirely explained by Markov predictability with no beyond-memory component. Maximum justified: URL-level PMI on these minimal deterministic hash-SPAs demonstrates state-conditioned Markov predictability only; history-conditioned beyond-Markov test decisively fails. NOT justified: (a) generalization to production SPAs with >4 states, stochastic transitions, auth/pagination/history routing where H_K=3 may not determine state; (b) beyond-memory falsification for richer representations (DOM, accessibility tree, visual layout) - untested here; (c) inference that C-WEB-DYNAMICS is globally false - remains HYPOTHESIS outside this bounded setting; (d) practical utility beyond Markov for SPIDER exploration on these testbeds - none.
